_comment: Every REPLACE_ME below is a value only the team can supply — see docs/PREREQUISITES.md. The deploy workflow refuses to run while any of them survives, so a half-filled file fails loudly instead of deploying something wrong.
_comment_ingresses: TWO hostnames, both full https:// URLs. Both feed spec.ingresses, and MUNINN_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is DERIVED from the pair in app.yaml — there is deliberately no third variable to keep in step. intern = naisdevice; ansatt = reachable for team members without developer access.
